# earliest start

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:earliestStart`](gmeow-earliestStart.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/earliestStart>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)

The earliest instant at which an event could have started — the lower bound of a fuzzy / approximate date ([xsd:dateTime](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime)). Pairs with [`gmeow:latestEnd`](gmeow-latestEnd.md) and a [`gmeow:temporalPrecision`](gmeow-temporalPrecision.md) value to model uncertainty without abandoning DL-clean base triples.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) -> [`xsd:dateTime`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:earliestStart`](gmeow-earliestStart.md) from [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) to [`xsd:dateTime`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
